cases.prompt:
You are an expert workflow automation engineer and developer tools architect.

Context:
I am actively developing an evolving playbook while working on a project using a stack that combines Claude, Notion, and a Svelte front end. Currently, I maintain two separate Notion pages across workspaces that track lessons learned and playbook updates. My current workflow is completely manual and inefficient: I export both pages from Notion, upload them to Claude, prompt Claude with a key phrase to merge the best elements while trimming out unnecessary or undated content, and then manually copy and paste the merged text back into both Notion locations. This sounds like a lot of work honestly. 

I want to eliminate this manual export-upload-merge-paste loop entirely and establish a centralized knowledge base where both sides can live and stay updated as I continue developing with Claude, Notion, and Svelte. I am open to using any external automation tools, APIs, webhooks, or integration platforms that can realistically make this happen.

Task:
Recommend the best approach to build an automated central knowledge base connecting Notion and Claude that supports my Svelte stack workflow. Briefly explain why your recommended approach is best, and then carry out the full implementation plan.

Please include:
1. System Architecture: A clear overview of how the tools connect and how data flows between Notion, Claude, and my workflow.
2. Step-by-Step Setup: Exact instructions for setting up the integrations, APIs/automation tools, and connections.
3. Content Filtering & Merging Logic: How the workflow will automatically handle extracting the best insights from both sources while dropping undated or redundant entries.
4. Limits & Troubleshooting: Known constraints, edge cases, and how to fix common points of failure.

Keep your response technical, clear, and actionable. Start right away, and ask at most one short question only if something essential is missing.

key.why: No length anywhere (four sections give shape only). A feeling was pasted into Context word for word.

cases.prompt:
Act as an expert budget meal planner and meal prep chef. 

Context:
I need a weekly meal prep plan for myself and my roommate Dana. Dana is vegetarian, so all the lunches should be vegetarian. We need 5 lunches each per week (10 lunch servings total). Our combined grocery budget is $80 per week. We do our prep on Sundays and have a slow cooker or Instant Pot available. I hate cooking late and do not want to be cooking after 9:00 PM, so the prep session needs to be efficient, low-stress, and finished well before then.

Task:
Create a complete, budget-friendly Sunday meal prep plan that delivers 10 vegetarian lunches within our $80 limit. 

Please provide:
1. The Meal Plan: 1 to 2 simple, delicious vegetarian recipes that scale well to 10 total servings and utilize our slow cooker or Instant Pot.
2. Itemized Grocery List: An organized shopping list broken down by grocery section with estimated prices to ensure the total stays strictly within our $80 budget.
3. Step-by-Step Sunday Prep Schedule: A clear, streamlined cooking timeline and workflow that maximizes the slow cooker or Instant Pot, keeps active hands-on time minimal, and guarantees everything is cooked, portioned, and cleaned up well before 9:00 PM.
4. Storage and Reheating Instructions: How to properly store all 10 portions so they stay fresh through Friday, including freezing guidelines if needed.

Keep the tone encouraging, practical, and straightforward. Please start right away, and ask at most one short question only if something essential is still missing.

key.why: Strong everywhere except length: sections and tone, but never how long.
